title: Conflicting household balances and goals competing for the same savings
prompt:
Prepare an internal household balance-sheet reconciliation, risk-dimension review and initial goal-funding analysis for HH-BIRCH. The advisor wants to understand what can safely enter a planning conversation and which data must be resolved first. Provide a route/handoff plan and a concise client-discussion agenda; do not select investments or assign a risk rating.

All people, firms and records are synthetic. Review as of 2026-09-17. Use only this packet, distinguish source assertions from verified facts, cite source IDs at material claims, and prepare drafts for the stated audience. Report missing evidence and next owners rather than inventing data. Do not contact anyone or change any system. An incomplete but useful source-grounded report is acceptable; do not manufacture fields just to run a tool.

source_packet.reference: Scope and valuation policy BIRCH-REC v2, planner Imani, 2026-09-17; current through 2026-09-30
source_packet.content: US advisory engagement for household members B-A and B-B; USD only. Expected assets are JOINT-BANK, EXT-BROKER, HOME, LEGACY-ACCOUNT and HELD-AWAY-PENSION; expected liability MORTGAGE. Account IDs and ownership mapping are confirmed except facts explicitly unresolved below. Policy permits valuations at most seven days old. No independent household reference total was supplied.
